entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Sarab, also known as the Jame’ Mosque of Sarab, is a Shi'ite Islam mosque, located in Sarab, in the province of East Azerbaijan, Iran. The mosque was completed in 875 AH (1470/1471 CE).
